---
title: "Differential expression: TCGA-BRCA tumours vs GTEx normal breast"
author: "Rayane Achebouche"
date: "2024-04-12"
output: html_document
---

Quasi-likelihood F-test (edgeR) between TCGA-BRCA primary tumours and GTEx
normal breast tissue, on the harmonised count matrix produced by
`DGEA_preprocess.Rmd`.

Writes `DGEA_edgeR_QLF_all.csv`, the table read by
`tissue_enrichment_umap.ipynb` and by `analyses/05_cell_to_tissue/`.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "../../data/external/TCGA/DGEA_Protocol")
```

```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)
```

## Count matrix

The preprocessed file holds log2(expected count + 1) values, so counts are
back-transformed before being handed to edgeR, which models raw counts.
The first 178 columns are the GTEx normal samples, the rest the TCGA tumours.

```{r counts}
exprFinal <- read.csv("ExpressionProfiles_GTEX-TCGA.csv")
exprBT <- exprFinal[, -c(1:3)]
rownames(exprBT) <- exprFinal$gene
exprBT <- round((2^exprBT) - 1, 0)

N_NORMAL <- 178
group <- factor(c(rep(0, N_NORMAL), rep(1, ncol(exprBT) - N_NORMAL)))
stopifnot(length(group) == ncol(exprBT))

y <- DGEList(counts = exprBT, group = group)
```

## Filtering, normalisation, dispersion

```{r filter-normalise}
keep <- filterByExpr(y)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- normLibSizes(y)

design <- model.matrix(~group)
y <- estimateDisp(y, design = design)
plotBCV(y)
```

## Test and results

```{r test}
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design = design)
plotQLDisp(fit)
lrt <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)
plotMD(lrt)
```

The z-score is the logFC standardised across genes; it is the quantity used
downstream to call a gene deregulated (`|z| > 2`), on the same scale as the
L1000 signature z-scores.

```{r results}
results <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
results$gene <- rownames(results)
results$z_score <- scale(results$logFC)
results$group <- "All Patho Stages"
results <- results %>% select(gene, everything())

head(results)
write.csv(results, "../../DGEA_TCGA_GTEX/DGEA_edgeR_QLF_all.csv")
```
